messages:
emma-sales: Heads up — Newton Health POC kicks off next Mon. Quick async sync on integrations, owners, and success criteria?
joanne-se: +1. SE checklist: API key exchange, webhook consumer, sample dataset + redaction. I can own the API integration.
mike-eng: I can own backend adapters and staging infra. ETA for initial spike: Wed. Need Newton's schema & webhook spec.
emma-sales: @mike-eng can you confirm we can handle their expected burst (200 r/s)?
mike-eng: We can on dedicated capacity. For POC we'll start on shared but raise autoscale caps. Planned config snippet: `max_concurrency: 50`, `burst_limit: 250`.
ara-pm: Proposed milestones: [1] staging ready (Wed) — owner: mike-eng, [2] integration tests (Thu) — owner: joanne-se, [3] demo & sign-off (next Mon) — owner: emma-sales. Any blockers?
sam-dev: Noted one immediate item: CORS prevents their UI token exchange. I'll add `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://app.newton.com` to the staging proxy.
joanne-se: Newton requires PHI redaction for sample records. @nina-qa can you produce an anonymized dataset?
nina-qa: Yes. I'll scrub and upload to `s3://redwood-pocs/newton/sample-v1.csv` by EOD today.
emma-sales: Draft success criteria: - end-to-end flow working with <=200ms median latency, - >=95% request success with PII redaction validated, - demo includes live editing + context window >=2k tokens. Thoughts?
mike-eng: 200ms median on shared infra is optimistic. Recommend canary on Dedicated for the demo to hit latency target. Is short-term dedicated burst approved?
emma-sales: Sales ok to fund a dedicated burst for demo day only. @ara-pm please confirm procurement so we can reserve capacity.
ara-pm: Confirmed. I'll file a Dedicated request ticket and tag mike-eng for setup.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staging env created: `newton-staging-42`. URL: https://staging.redwood.internal/newton — credentials pending.
sam-dev: Created service user `svc-newton`. Will share creds in 1:1 and add env var `NEWTON_API_KEY` to staging.
joanne-se: I'll add smoke tests (example path: `tests/smoke/newton_integration.py`) to run nightly against staging.
nina-qa: I'll perform manual spot checks after deploy and sign off on redaction checks.
emma-sales: Can we do a final readiness check Fri 09:30 PT? If green I'll schedule the demo invite for Tue.
mike-eng: Fine for Fri. Open blockers: need Newton's webhook payload schema and confirmation of their CORS origins.
joanne-se: I'll ping the Newton SE now for the schema and CORS origins :mailbox_with_mail:.
emma-sales: Thanks all — will follow up with calendar invite once Fri check is green. :rocket:
